CustomField.description: Controls whether file owners can open a file in Google Drive. When enabled, the owner is given view access to that one file for a limited time. Leave this off to keep files reachable only from Salesforce.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Lets file owners open a file directly in Google Drive with view access for a limited time. Leave this off to keep files reachable only from Salesforce.
CustomField.label: Is Open In Google Drive Enabled?
